quality_note: Probability screening on the ten existing deterministic assets only; not a design or safety assessment.

uncertainty.model: PC5 Cramér-Rao formal phase-noise lower bound; excludes atmospheric, ramp and unwrapping errors

method.vertical_assumption: vertical displacement = LOS / cos(local incidence); horizontal motion is assumed negligible
method.sample_sigma_assumption: independent Gaussian formal phase-noise samples; spatial covariance and atmospheric/unwrapping errors are not modeled
method.scope: The ten IDs in data/central_valley/assets.json, matched to risk/central_valley_infra.geojson; 3,238-source corridor file is not exhaustively scored.
